uutiset.t: Tributes for Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor after his death aged 65
uutiset.s: Simon Le Bon and his other bandmates say Taylor "brought an indelible fire and swagger to our music".

uutiset.t: Diesel tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes sinks near Ibiza, killing one
uutiset.s: The possible environmental damage is still being assessed by Spain's sea rescue service.

uutiset.t: Seven injured, four critically, after Bangkok oil refinery explosion
uutiset.s: Black smoke could be seen across Bangkok's skyline after the blast, while officials urged residents to leave the area.

uutiset.t: Hope for millions as cheaper HIV prevention jab reaches Africa
uutiset.s: Lenacapavir, administered as an injection twice a year, is nearly 100% effective at preventing HIV infection.

uutiset.t: US Army says controlled blast of explosives in Iowa was 'huge success'
uutiset.s: Officials say no lead has been detected in the surrounding area, which continues to be tested following concerns from locals.

uutiset.t: Myanmar refuses to comply with parts of ICJ genocide ruling
uutiset.s: A landmark ruling by the International Court of Justice (ICJ) convicted Myanmar of genocide against its Rohingya minority.

uutiset.t: Hamas political official and wife among eight Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza
uutiset.s: The killings are the latest from a series of near daily attacks by Israel against what it says are Hamas targets.

uutiset.t: New UK-EU treaty has 10-year termination clause
uutiset.s: Text of the treaties will be published this afternoon, alongside legislation designed to enact the bulk of the deal.

uutiset.t: Musk's plan to send a million SpaceX data satellites into space approved
uutiset.s: The Starmind constellation aims to be the most cost and energy-efficient way to meet the growing demand for AI computing power.

uutiset.t: Watch: Alaskan flying team airdrops Thanksgiving turkeys to remote communities
uutiset.s: For the last few years, the "turkey bombers" have taken to the skies for the benefit of residents in off-grid communities.

uutiset.t: Deadly fire erupts near Cairo killing dozens of people
uutiset.s: At least 31 people have died in a large fire on a busy highway in Cairo, after a fuel tanker overturned, says Egypt's health ministry.

uutiset.t: Two screenings of Pakistani TV show cancelled in India after backlash
uutiset.s: The show, Dar-e-Nijaat, has become a sensation in India but is now embroiled in a political row.

uutiset.t: Guinea orders residents to clean up the capital months after deadly rubbish dump collapse
uutiset.s: The capital's main rubbish dump has been closed since the disaster, leading to rubbish piling up in the streets.

uutiset.t: FedEx plane overshoots Miami runway, causing brief suspension of flights at airport
uutiset.s: The brief stoppage came on the eve of the US Thanksgiving holiday, one of the busiest travel days of the year.

uutiset.t: Thirteen dead as mine disaster highlights illegal hunt for gold
uutiset.s: Indonesian authorities say another 13 are missing in the illegal gold mine, which flooded on Monday.
